title: Running
description: Running-only board: volume, pace, load, zone time, economy, power records, cadence, ascent and a recent-sessions table. Scoped to core.sport.discipline = 'run' (sport_codes running / trail_running / treadmill).

list.name: athlete_id
list.query: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id
list.definition: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id

list.name: Notes
list.rawSql: SELECT n.local_date::timestamp AS time, n.kind AS text, n.note AS tooltip FROM core.note n WHERE n.athlete_id = $athlete_id ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekly volume -- hours
panels.description: core.activity, run discipline only (is_parent = false, joined to core.sport on discipline = 'run'). sum(duration_s)/3600 per ISO week -- duration_s is timer time, the correct volume column (elapsed_s includes stops). Shown as a separate panel from weekly distance rather than a dual-axis overlay, since hours and kilometres move independently when pace varies week to week and a shared axis would compress one series.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', a.local_date)::timestamp AS time, sum(a.duration_s)/3600.0 AS "Hours" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'run' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekly volume -- distance
panels.description: core.activity, run discipline only. sum(distance_m)/1000 per ISO week, in kilometres. Companion panel to the hours chart on the left -- kept separate rather than a right-hand axis override so both series stay readable at their native scale.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', a.local_date)::timestamp AS time, sum(a.distance_m)/1000.0 AS "Kilometres" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'run' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Pace per session
panels.description: Average pace of every run in the period, against the current threshold pace read from core.threshold. Values are seconds per kilometre so the series stays a number the chart can scale, formatted as hh:mm:ss for reading -- 00:03:58 is 3:58 /km. Careful with the direction: a lower point is a FASTER run, so a dip is a good session and the curve moves opposite to the effort. Sessions without distance are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.start_time_local::timestamp AS time, a.duration_s / NULLIF(a.distance_m, 0) * 1000 AS "Pace (min/km)" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'run' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) AND a.distance_m > 0 ORDER BY 1

SELECT a.start_time_local::timestamp AS time, t.ftp_pace_s_per_km AS "Threshold pace (min/km)" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code CROSS JOIN core.threshold t WHERE a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'run' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) AND a.distance_m > 0 AND t.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND t.discipline = 'run' AND upper_inf(t.validity) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekly TSS
panels.description: mart.activity_wide has no athlete_id, joined to core.activity (is_parent = false) and core.sport (discipline = 'run') for scope. Bars: sum(tss) per ISO week. Overlaid line: count of run sessions in that week with needs_manual_rpe = true. A low TSS bar caused by a missing RPE entry (rather than a genuinely easy week) will show a nonzero count on the same week -- read the two series together, not the TSS bar alone.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', aw.local_date)::timestamp AS time, sum(aw.tss) AS "TSS" FROM mart.activity_wide aw JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = aw.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'run' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(aw.local_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('week', aw.local_date)::timestamp AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE aw.needs_manual_rpe) AS "Sessions needing manual RPE" FROM mart.activity_wide aw JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = aw.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'run' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(aw.local_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Time in pace zones -- weekly
panels.description: mart.power_pace_zone_time (zone_system = 'pace_pct_vth'), no athlete_id: joined to core.activity (is_parent = false, athlete_id filter) and core.sport (discipline = 'run'). Stacked bars Z1..Z5, hours per ISO week, from sum(seconds) FILTER per zone_code. This view currently covers few sessions (pace-zone time depends on the same threshold-pace-driven classification, not every run has it computed yet), so most weeks may show little or nothing here.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', z.local_date)::timestamp AS time, sum(z.seconds) FILTER (WHERE z.zone_code = 'Z1')/3600.0 AS "Z1", sum(z.seconds) FILTER (WHERE z.zone_code = 'Z2')/3600.0 AS "Z2", sum(z.seconds) FILTER (WHERE z.zone_code = 'Z3')/3600.0 AS "Z3", sum(z.seconds) FILTER (WHERE z.zone_code = 'Z4')/3600.0 AS "Z4", sum(z.seconds) FILTER (WHERE z.zone_code = 'Z5')/3600.0 AS "Z5" FROM mart.power_pace_zone_time z JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = z.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE z.zone_system = 'pace_pct_vth' AND a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'run' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(z.local_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: HR zones -- weekly
panels.description: mart.hr_zone_time, no athlete_id: joined to core.activity (is_parent = false, athlete_id filter) and core.sport (discipline = 'run'). Stacked bars Z1..Z5, hours per ISO week (%LTHR based). This is the cross-check for the pace-zone panel: HR zone time is populated on any run with a heart-rate stream, including the 165 CSV-history sessions with no power stream, so it should have broader coverage than pace zones.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', z.local_date)::timestamp AS time, sum(z.seconds) FILTER (WHERE z.zone_code = 'Z1')/3600.0 AS "Z1", sum(z.seconds) FILTER (WHERE z.zone_code = 'Z2')/3600.0 AS "Z2", sum(z.seconds) FILTER (WHERE z.zone_code = 'Z3')/3600.0 AS "Z3", sum(z.seconds) FILTER (WHERE z.zone_code = 'Z4')/3600.0 AS "Z4", sum(z.seconds) FILTER (WHERE z.zone_code = 'Z5')/3600.0 AS "Z5" FROM mart.hr_zone_time z JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = z.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'run' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(z.local_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Efficiency factor
panels.description: mart.activity_wide, no athlete_id: joined to core.activity (is_parent = false, athlete_id filter) and core.sport (discipline = 'run'). Points, one per qualifying steady session (duration_s BETWEEN 2700 AND 14400, data_quality IN ('good','fair'), efficiency_factor NOT NULL) -- consecutive points are different sessions, not a continuous trend. Only about 6 runs currently qualify, since 165 of the 171 runs are CSV history with data_quality = 'unknown'.

targets.rawSql: SELECT aw.start_time_local::timestamp AS time, aw.efficiency_factor AS "Efficiency factor" FROM mart.activity_wide aw JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = aw.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'run' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(aw.local_date) AND aw.duration_s BETWEEN 2700 AND 14400 AND aw.data_quality IN ('good','fair') AND aw.efficiency_factor IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Decoupling
panels.description: mart.activity_wide, no athlete_id: joined to core.activity (is_parent = false, athlete_id filter) and core.sport (discipline = 'run'). Points, same qualifying-session filter as the efficiency factor panel (duration_s BETWEEN 2700 AND 14400, data_quality IN ('good','fair'), decoupling_pct NOT NULL) -- consecutive points are different sessions. Only about 6 runs currently qualify, since 165 of the 171 runs are CSV history with data_quality = 'unknown'.

targets.rawSql: SELECT aw.start_time_local::timestamp AS time, aw.decoupling_pct AS "Decoupling (%)" FROM mart.activity_wide aw JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = aw.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'run' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(aw.local_date) AND aw.duration_s BETWEEN 2700 AND 14400 AND aw.data_quality IN ('good','fair') AND aw.decoupling_pct IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Running power curve
panels.description: mart.power_curve_best (kind = 'run_power'), no athlete_id and no sport_code: joined to core.activity (is_parent = false, athlete_id filter) and core.sport (discipline = 'run') for scope, plus a local_date window per series. Four overlaid windows -- last 28 days / 90 days / 365 days / all time -- each taking max(value) per duration_s so the curve shows the single best effort at each duration within that window, not an average. X axis is duration in seconds, not time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pc.duration_s AS "Duration (s)", max(pc.value) AS "Last 28 days (W)" FROM mart.power_curve_best pc JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = pc.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE pc.kind = 'run_power' AND a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'run' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND pc.local_date >= current_date - interval '28 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT pc.duration_s AS "Duration (s)", max(pc.value) AS "Last 90 days (W)" FROM mart.power_curve_best pc JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = pc.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE pc.kind = 'run_power' AND a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'run' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND pc.local_date >= current_date - interval '90 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT pc.duration_s AS "Duration (s)", max(pc.value) AS "Last 365 days (W)" FROM mart.power_curve_best pc JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = pc.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE pc.kind = 'run_power' AND a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'run' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND pc.local_date >= current_date - interval '365 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT pc.duration_s AS "Duration (s)", max(pc.value) AS "All time (W)" FROM mart.power_curve_best pc JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = pc.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE pc.kind = 'run_power' AND a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'run' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cadence trend
panels.description: core.activity, run discipline only. avg_cadence per session, points. Present on all 171 runs, but the absolute value is source-dependent: Garmin reports avg_cadence for running as either one-leg steps/min (roughly 85) or both-legs steps/min (roughly 170) depending on the recording source, and this dashboard does not assert which. Read this panel for TREND over time, not against an absolute cadence target.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.start_time_local::timestamp AS time, a.avg_cadence AS "Avg cadence" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'run' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) AND a.avg_cadence IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekly ascent
panels.description: core.activity, run discipline only. sum(ascent_m) per ISO week, in metres. Vertical volume matters for trail prep -- watch for weeks that are high in distance/hours but flat in ascent, or vice versa.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', a.local_date)::timestamp AS time, sum(a.ascent_m) AS "Ascent (m)" FROM core.activity a JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code WHERE a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'run' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(a.local_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recent runs
panels.description: Every run in the period, most recent first. Pace is spelled the way the watch spells it, minutes and seconds per kilometre, and is blank for a run recorded without distance rather than shown as zero. Duration is timer time, not elapsed. Clicking a row opens the Session detail dashboard for that activity.

targets.rawSql: SELECT aw.local_date AS "Date", aw.sport AS "Sport", aw.name AS "Name", aw.duration_s AS "Duration", aw.distance_m/1000.0 AS "Distance (km)", CASE WHEN pace.s_per_km IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (pace.s_per_km / 60)::text || ':' || lpad((pace.s_per_km % 60)::text, 2, '0') END AS "Pace (min/km)", aw.avg_hr AS "Avg HR", aw.avg_power AS "Avg power (W)", aw.tss AS "TSS", aw.tss_method AS "TSS method", aw.data_quality AS "Data quality", aw.activity_id::text AS "activity_id", (extract(epoch from a.start_time) * 1000)::bigint AS "start_ms", (extract(epoch from a.start_time + make_interval(secs => coalesce(a.elapsed_s, a.duration_s))) * 1000)::bigint AS "end_ms", coalesce(a.elapsed_s, a.duration_s)::bigint * 1000 AS "duration_ms" FROM mart.activity_wide aw JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = aw.activity_id JOIN core.sport s ON s.sport_code = a.sport_code CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT round(aw.duration_s * 1000.0 / NULLIF(aw.distance_m, 0))::int AS s_per_km) pace WHERE a.is_parent = false AND s.discipline = 'run' AND a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(aw.local_date) ORDER BY aw.local_date DESC
